When Karina wakes up inside a novel, she realizes she’s been given a chance to change the tragic lives of the male lead, Roland Bleuet, and his sister, Melisa. Karina saves up as much money as she can and makes a run for it with the children. But to her dismay, the money she has saved up isn’t enough to get the three of them to the capital. Instead, they head for Torres where Karina bumps into Duke Claude Torres, a “talent fanatic” who is obsessed with collecting talented individuals and an antagonist who will negatively impact Roland’s life in the future. Will Karina be able to protect Roland and Melisa from all dangers and give her adoptive children a better future?

Aizawa a high school student whose father was killed by “Gokudo”, hunts the killer with burning eyes. His goal, driven by a thirst for overwhelming power, is it revenge, or something else…? In a yakuza world awash with violence, ordinary people ignite their fury and pull the trigger!!

A pulse-pounding masterpiece from young master Kiyoto Shitara: a villainous supernatural action saga like no other.

An 18-year-old teenager woke up one day to find herself seven years older and married. One minute she was just starting college, the next minute she became a go-getter CEO and someone’s wife! To add to her surprise, her husband happened to be Jiang Jingyan, the “underachiever” at school, with whom she never saw eye to eye.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

153060.description:
What would happen when a man once in special forces met a rebellious girl? By accident, she became his only love. She lost everything overnight because of him and thus became his beloved person, coddling her all his life.

(Source: Webnovels)

153061.description:
Abandoned, framed, and bad endings... Our transmigrating female support has had enough! Why must the side character always have to go along with the main lead?! Starting from this world, she decided to take fate into her own hands, no longer following The System's instructions! To fulfill her own dreams, she will overcome every challenge in her way, while having revenge on those who mistreated her before…

153063.description:
Man’s infatuation with womanhood has existed for many centuries. The mythical oracle Tiresias, who is said to have lived as a woman for 7 years, concluded that a woman enjoyed sex 10 times more than man. That story is now retold in a sci-fi setting, where it is possible for one to change their gender in a Ghost in the Shell-esque cyber space.

(Source: Little White Butterflies)

Note: Includes FARFALLA armonia.

153064.description:
Professor Ethan Shoyo Smith is a renowned botanical researcher. When his assistant goes on leave, his mentor introduces him to Takumi, a handsome research student. Despite Ethan's exotic looks and flashy reputation, he leads a less than glamorous life. He begins to worry that although Takumi works every day without complaint, he's somehow disappointed to be working with him.

One day, Hanako, a plant that Ethan is researching, attacks Takumi, causing him to inhale her nectar and be overcome with lecherous desire. Ethan tries to help calm him down, but is brushed off when Takumi says he'll take matters into his own hands. Before Ethan knows it, the tables have been turned...! The up-and-down love story of a clueless scientist and his cute assistant!!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

title.native: 僕のイエローカーテン

153065.description:
She has a good personality, is popular, and has a lot of money: Gu Do-Yeon, the daughter of the perfect G company president. However, Do-Yeon's step-sister Gu Yi-Seo is just unlucky and annoying. Who in the world is perfect? In the end, Yi-Seo secretly hides in an office to dig up Do-Yeon's weakness. There, she discovers a completely different side to the Do-Yeon she knew.

(Lezhin, translated)

Note:
- Chapter count includes a prologue.
- Part of Lezhin's Gwanggong Collection (광공단편선). A gwanggong (광공, hanja: 狂攻) character is obsessed with the object of their desire, similar to the Japanese "yandere". Scanlations have erroneously translated this to "GwangGong Apartment/Industrial Complex", which may have caused confusion.

153066.description:
This is the true story of Jun, who was born with autism in South Korea, a country that views disability with extreme suspicion. After years of trying to “cure” their son, his parents discovered his great passion for traditional music, and through his extraordinary talent, Jun will be able to fully express himself as he has never done before.

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue and epilogue.

153067.description: Kaede Momose leaves the hustle and bustle of Tokyo for a new life alone in the mountains. On his first day there, he goes to greet his neighbor and meets Riku Tsukumo, who also lives alone in the mountains. Clean air and mountain fare; so begins a cozy mountain-life romance!

153068.description:
In addition to human beings, this world also contains fairies, spirits, ghosts, and monsters, the supernatural and the strange. When Zhang Quan, a man with the ability to see "demons" encounters Shen Qing, who's being harrassed by a "demon"... A rowdy, day-to-day excorcism begins!

(Source: Webnovel)

153069.description:
"Mom, Dad... I'm transgender." Unwelcome even in my own home, my life was a hellscape of discrimination and prejudice. That is, until I met him...

TRIGGER WARNING: This product contains slurs used as insults against transgender individuals that may be emotionally damaging to some readers.

(Source: Renta!)

153070.description:
Muzel Clave Laurent Morze is destined to die during the war caused by the heroine of the novel "Mesiria." In order to avoid her horrid fate and live a carefree life, she decides to change the future with a special ability that allows her to look at the memories of people and objects with a single touch. She soon gets involved in the dramatic events of the original story in an attempt to make things go in her favor... but will her touch be enough to ensure the happy ending she's always wanted?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Would You Like a Cup of Tea?
お茶を一杯いかがですか?
มาดื่มชากันสักแก้วไหมคะ?

153071.description:
Born with a scar seen as undesirable, Erica Corr thought she might never get married. That is, until she is betrothed to the ruthless emperor Carl Lakin as a noble consort. With several of his previous consorts having turned up dead, it is predicted that the sweet, gentle Erica won’t last very long. However, she discovers that beneath Carl’s twisted exterior lies a surprisingly soft side and some scars of his own. But is Erica strong enough to heal this tyrant? Or will she be his latest victim?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: A Outra Face de um Tirano

153072.description:
Centuries ago, Mago was punished by a god for writing a calamitous book. She was doomed to be repeatedly reborn until she destroyed every copy of her novel under the surveillance of Ha Lib, the deity's errand boy. There are now only five copies remaining, but Mago's quest to end her cycle of rebirth is complicated when Do Kyujin, a charismatic CEO, joins the search for his own purposes. With yet another mysterious figure thwarting them at every turn, will Mago finally be able to rest in peace?

(Source: Tapas)

153074.description:
He had always kept his mouth shut about his mysterious life and the mastermind hidden in the dark, but it causes his lover to be dragged into a huge conspiracy. How will they get out of this? When the truth comes out, can their lives return to normal?

(Source: WebComics, edited)

153075.description:
After a devastating end in her previous life, Mo Jiaojiao, now reborn as a three-year-old, is determined to alter the fate of Mo Yuan state. She quickly learns that her father is not only a ruthless tyrant, but forced her to adhere to strict royal etiquette. Yet, against all odds, she soon becomes his beloved child, and even forms a unique bond with the hostage prince. Mo Jiaojiao might not know it but a begrudgingly protective emperor slowly realizes how much of a treasure she is to him.

(Source: Tapas)

153076.description:
Princess Renia Alesdubois had finally found happiness with her husband Clovis Jenoff, the Grand Duke. But when the empire finds her guilty of her husband's murder amidst political chaos, a dying wish to set everything right sends her back before it all began. Armed with memories of the past, Renia decides to call off her engagement in order to save her beloved. As she goes to extreme lengths to keep the past from repeating, she finds that some things are not at all what she expected.

(Source: Tapas)

153077.description:
Prince Bei Chen is set for an arranged marriage, but his bride ends up being someone different. He takes in the fraudulent Chu Mei as his concubine, even though his heart lies with men. And so begins a fake romance between two arrogant people who rely on each other for their own means.

(Source: INKR)
synonyms: Soaring Phoenix from the East Palace

153078.description:
Ra Hyeon just got the exciting news that she's passed the Bar Exam and is headed to law school. But what should've been one of the best days of her life turns out to be the worst as the shock causes her to have a heart attack and die. As she pleads for her life in her final moments, she is given one last chance to evade death. All she has to do is live as Daphne Kerrece, the daughter of a noble household, and win the heart of her new husband, the emperor. But with a looming deadline, a husband who's already cast away four brides before her, and many hoping to see her fail, this won't be as easy as it sounds. And, when all is said and done, is it even what Ra Hyeon really wants?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Now I Will Take the Emperor's Heart
เกมรักคว้าหัวใจจักรพรรดิ

153079.description:
After stumbling into her own book and becoming a countryside maid, Behania's only goal is to save enough money, reach the capital, and find a way home. Unfortunately, those plans are ruined when her employer is murdered at the hands of Radeiel Krainu, the novel's psychotic villain. To save herself, Behania aids Radeiel's escape and later offers to help him in return for his protection on her journey. Little does she know that in doing so, she'll end up rewriting her story entirely...

(Source: Tapas)

153080.description:
Navigating the uncertainty of early adulthood is no easy feat, as Hong Woo-Ree is realizing on his year off from college. Not only is he trying to make it as a published author, but he also thinks that his best friend, Gong Min-Nee, is a vampire! After making some flawed assumptions, Woo-Ree believes that Min-Nee's secretive behavior comes from hiding his "true" identity-- he's completely unaware that Min-Nee isn't actually a vampire, and just has a huge crush on him. While Woo-Ree struggles to get his writing published and protect Min-Nee's "secret," Min-Nee must find a way to confess his feelings for the oblivious Woo-Ree. Will these two be able to reconcile their misunderstandings and allow for a real relationship to blossom?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: เพื่อนบ้านผมเป็นแวมไพร์?!

title.english: Could the Boy Next Door be a Vampire?

153081.description:
I was helping my sister win the heart of the game's top-ranked player, but it turned out to be a total disaster! I was even ridiculed by that gaming master!!! I guess no one can defy Murphy's Law! Just as the game was loading... Ding! Notice: Your husband is now online!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

title.english: This Sweet Online Date is a Disaster!

153082.description:
On a stormy night, Shen Nianque found herself fleeing danger and accidentally took refuge in a private residence. Inside, she encountered a strikingly handsome young man. Contrary to her expectations, he was unafraid of her threats and even assisted her in treating her gunshot wounds. Shen Nianque thought their paths would never cross again, yet to her surprise, this seemingly delicate young man, who was a year her junior, started to persistently seek her out. His attention towards her grew increasingly intense and unsettling as time passed...

(Source: INKR)
synonyms: Pestered by the Yandere Once Again

153083.description:
A 21st century, talented Feng Shui expert, reincarnates into a frail body in ancient times. The original good-for-nothing host is not only ugly, but her birth father favors the concubine more than the wife, birth mother was framed with adultery and stripped of her rank, twin brother was poisoned by her second mother, her fiancé and concubine-sister hooked up and worked together to bring about her tragic death. After Xiao Lingyun is reincarnated, she uses secret techniques of Feng Shui to get back at those who had previously ridiculed and abused her. From the lowest of low to the highest peak of cultivation, she flies towards the immortal realm.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: Dealing With the Prince of Misfortune

153084.description:

As he's being sworn into office, he thinks his life couldn't get any better... but that all comes crashing when a monster falls through the roof of the National Assembly! Yin Che: Get lost.

Friendly Big Bad Wolf Jiang Yao VS Reclusive Little Bunny Yin Che

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

153156.description:
Yoshika is almost 18 years old. She is worried about the future because she's not good at studying and she has some problems at home... In the midst of these bewildering days, she sees a "punching bag" act on the street. She is attracted by their sign, "For every punch you land, you win 100 yen." Her life begins to change as a result of this challenge.

(Source: Shonen Jump+, translated)

153157.description:
The target actually looks just like me, but I have to complete the task anyways? And kill him?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

153158.description:
When a sly fox meets a slyer one, the hunter becomes the hunted.

""Seeing this letter is like seeing me in person. Last night, I had a dream within a dream, and in that dream, you were there. Waking up from both layers of sleep, it felt like I lost you twice, and I was filled with great unease. Enclosed with this letter is also a blank piece of Xuan paper, as white and pure as the moonlight when I thought of you last night."

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

153160.description:
Li Zhenruo never thought he would be the first to be kicked out of the Li family’s internal struggle between brothers. If that wasn't enough, he then lost his life in a meticulously planned “accident”. However, this was not the end for Li Zhenruo. After waking up, he discovered that he had turned into a Garfield cat, giving him the opportunity to return to the Li family and investigate the truth of which of his three older brothers was behind that “accident” of his. At the same time, he was shocked to realize that this body did not seem to be that of a normal cat. It could… transform!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

153161.description:
A young girl who lost her mother and lives alone with her father. She thinks the river in her neighborhood is the Sanzu River, and she sends letters to her dead mother. One day, she decides to enter the Sanzu River to be with her mother...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: さみしがりやな私たち

153162.description:
The golden ratio is the symbol of architectural aesthetics, as well as the most ideal proportion for human body. Huo Zhixiao’s bed partners all meet the golden ratio figure standard. Therefore, Ding Yinan never imagined waking up next to him. "-0.618 is universally recognized as the most aesthetically pleasing proportion. But in my eyes, you are the only aesthetic standard."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

153163.description:
1. My Beautiful Green Palace (マイ ビューティフル グリーン パレス)
2. Sakana no Hahen (魚の破片)
3. Shouzou (肖像)
4. LUNPY STONE
5. Saigo no Natsuyasumi (最後の夏休み)
6. Yoru no Shizuku (夜の雫)
7. Rokugatsu-byou (六月病)
8. Jouzu na Hidariko no Tsukai Hou (上手な左庫の使い方)

My Beautiful Green Palace: Ima Ichiko Sakuhinshuu

title.native: マイ・ビューティフル・グリーンパレス

153164.description:
The Crown Prince fell from his horse off a cliff and disappeared without a trace. After losing his memory, he was picked up and secretly hidden away by his younger brother, Prince Ke, right under everyone's noses. Yet this ambitious "good brother" was actually one of the masterminds behind the Crown Prince’s fall. While storms brewed in the court and people lived in fear, within Prince Ke’s residence, passions ran wild night after night. The muddleheaded amnesiac Crown Prince became Prince Ke’s beloved pet — until his memory returned and he finally remembered everything.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

153165.description:
Haruhi, who grew up in an orphanage, has five "Ashinaga Uncles" who write to him once a month and help him with his school fees and expenses. Kasuga began to look for them in order to thank them, but somehow ended up living with Natsumi, the caretaker of an apartment building, and his lover Yasuyuhiro....

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Note: Dates based on the volume releases.

title.native: あしながおじさん達の行方

153166.description:
An Xi grew up in a radiation shelter, and never met an outsider until he turned 16. The mysterious outsider is strong and tall, and An Xi can't take his eyes off him. When An Xi was attacked by a mutant invader, the outsider saved him and they formed a friendship. An Xi made up a name for him — Fei Tu. And then Fei Tu shared his secret with An Xi…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

153167.description:
Younger love interest, mutual unrequited love.
Yu Songnian looked at Shen Shu and said with a wry smile, "Marriage should still be with someone you like, right?"
Shen Shu: "Didn't expect you to be such a romantic. Aren't most people in our circle in business marriages?" He treated it as a transaction.
But in reality, Shen Shu felt like he had picked up a dirty little puppy. He would clean him up and restore him to his former beautiful self.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

153168.description: Note: Published on Holiday Yasumi's PixivFANBOX account.

title.native: しぼって♡うばって♡リサリサちゃん ～このクラスの授業はすべて聖実習です～
title.romaji: Shibotte♡Ubatte♡Lisa Lisa-chan: Kono Class no Jugyou wa Subete Sei Jisshuu desu

153171.description:
No escape from this curvaceous, illusory beauty.

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2022-08, 2026-07

title.native: 親友歴五年、今さら君に惚れたなんて言えない
title.romaji: Shinyuureki Go-nen, Imasara Kimi ni Horeta Nante Ienai

title.native: 拾ったギャルをお世話したら、○フレになったんだが。
title.romaji: Hirotta Gal wo Osewa Shitara, ○ Fure ni Nattanda ga.

153174.description:
Possessive and supremely secure Movie Emperor (Gong) vs. Image-conscious and exceptionally dedicated TV Emperor (Shou).

Two male actors, bound together by a shocking group sex scandal, tell the story of their sweet, mutually doting professional relationship.

Liang Yu: "The moment he landed here with me, this place became spring." (Liang Yu's boyfriend filter is maxed out, spoiling him to the extreme!!)

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

153175.description:
Justin is loved by two men, and it's tearing him apart. His past is haunted by the complicated love-hate relationship with his first love - Alex, who also happens to be his adopted uncle and a powerful CEO. But in his current life, Mills, a seductive lieutenant has always been by his side. How will he make a choice?

(Source: INKR, edited)

153177.description:
Ian, a former gangster, tries to leave his dangerous past behind but his long-time friend and partner TJ, who he shared everything with, refuses to let him go. And, click. A thoughtless finger slip leads Jo to jump into Ian's life and shows Ian what being "ordinary" is for the first time. In the corner of the city where neon signs flash, three men's fates begin to intertwine. Who will Ian choose in the end?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 負けヒロインと俺が付き合っていると周りから勘違いされ、幼馴染みと修羅場になった
title.romaji: Make Heroine to Ore ga Tsukiatte Iruto Mawari kara Kanchigai Sare, Osananajimi to Shuraba ni Natta

title.native: 甘えたい幼馴染は「なんでも言うコト聞く券」を持って、キスをしたいと迫ってくる
title.romaji: Amaetai Osananajimi wa "Nan demo Iu Koto Kikuken" wo Motte, Kiss wo Shitai to Sematte Kuru

153181.description:
Rinne Irako has been sentenced to execution by guillotine. Host to the powers of a dragon, she has a potential for destruction that endangers humanity. However, a mysterious attacker provides an opportunity that could change her fate. She falls from the sky, right in the path of Ryuunosuke Dazai, who is very eager to help. Luckily, there is a way for him to save both Rinne and the world. All he has to do...is marry her?! With a ring on his finger and a soul bond between them that regulates her powers, his days living with a beautiful dragon girl have begun.

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Dantoudai no Hanayome: Sekai wo Horobosu Futsutsuka na Tatsuki desu ga.

title.english: Guillotine Bride: I’m just a dragon girl who’ll destroy the world.
title.native: 断頭台の花嫁　世界を滅ぼすふつつかな竜姫ですが。
title.romaji: Dantoudai no Hanayome: Sekai wo Horobosu Futsutsuka na Watashi desu ga.

title.native: お薬、出します！ 追放された薬師の少女は、極めたポーションで辺境の薬屋から成り上がる
title.romaji: Okusuri, Dashimasu!: Tsuihou Sareta Kusushi no Shoujo wa, Kiwameta Potion de Henkyou no Kusuriya Kara Nariagaru

153183.description:
My sister enrolled in an all-girls knight training academy. Even at the kingdom's most prestigious academy, my little sister, a brilliant girl, excels in every subject...

"I'm telling you that my brother is so much stronger than me!"

No, I'm just an ordinary guy.......?
(*That's not true. He just doesn't realize it yet.)
Because of that boast, the top knight of the school challenges me to a mock battle.
(*The strongest knight of the school realized their difference in strength in an instant.)
Now make sure you cool down properly after exercise!
(*My brother's massage made the lady knight so happy that even other nobles were impressed!)

Just doing my normal thing, I somehow caught the attention of the princess?

A harem of lady knights for a self-proclaimed ordinary guy who doesn't recognize his own power!

(Source: Fantasia Bunko, translated)
synonyms: After my sister enrolling in Girl Knights' School, I become a HERO

title.native: 妹が女騎士学園に入学したらなぜか救国の英雄になりました。ぼくが。
title.romaji: Imouto ga Onna Kishi Gakuen ni Nyuugaku Shitara Nazeka Kyuukoku no Eiyuu ni Narimashita. Boku ga.

153184.description:
Han Ga-Ram was the youngest lead vocalist of the popular idol group Faiz. After serving in the army, he applies for an audition program to become a singer again. After receiving confirmation he can participate in the audition, Ga-Ram meets his middle school friend Kang Su-Won, who is now the general manager of the CN group.

"We were friends with each other and cared about one another a lot, but the friendship ended badly. He offered me a deal that I couldn't resist."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

153185.description:
"You'll build a child making harem!" All the girls at school are the candidates for my bride-to-be!? One day, the forced peerless life suddenly begins!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Released in 30 episodes in long-strip format, and subsequently sold as 10 chapters in traditional format.

title.english: Trying Out a New Girl Everyday
title.native: 日替り彼女と子作りハーレム！

153186.description:
"I can't take it anymore..." We went down a big, wet slide together... And when it rubbed up against her swimsuit, my strong-headed childhood friend turned to me with tears in her eyes...!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 18 episodes and 6 chapters respectively.

title.english: A Sexy Incident on the Water Slide
title.native: ウォータースライダーで水着っ娘とぶつかった結果、エロすぎる奇跡が起きた。
title.romaji: Water Slider de Mizugikko to Butsukatta Kekka, Ero Sugiru Kiseki ga Okita.

"Stop! We'll be found out...!" This truck is rockin' and rollin' while we're bumping uglies right in front of the customers! Results: orgasms galore!

My tentacles are out of control! They play with girls and make them come! They wrap around their big tits, play with their clits, slide inside them... without their consent!

153189.description: It is mid-spring in the country of Brior. Olivia, a duchess, pretends to be a fool under the order of her fiancé, the crown prince, Alan, and suddenly, he tells her that their engagement has been annulled. Olivia was stunned, but she was even more confused when the second prince, Cyrus, suddenly appeared in front of a large audience and asked her to marry him. This is a romantic love story of a genius daughter who is inexperienced in love and a prince who wants to make his long-time love come true begins!
synonyms: My Engagement With The Prince Was Cancelled So I Will Stop Pretending To Be a Fool

153196.description:
Naoko is a professional woman working for a major travel agency in Tokyo. Supported by her understanding husband, she thought she had the perfect life both at work and at home, until one day her husband suddenly disappears, leaving behind a large amount of debt, his company bankrupt. Naoko decides to wait for her husband's return while working off their debts by walking through the door of Kaguraya, a long-established ryokan in Kanazawa, Ishikawa Prefecture. The proprietress of the inn is Naoko's mother-in-law, who had disowned the couple, refusing to recognize their marriage. Naoko manages to stay on at Kaguraya despite being told, "I won't recognize an 'enjimon' (outsider) as my daughter-in-law!"

Naoko is determined to start her life anew, with the goal to eventually become the proprietress!

(Source: Be-Love, translated)

Note: An adaptation of the 2010 live-action TV drama series of the same title.

153197.description:
Sumire Shirayuki is a piano teacher who can match anyone when it comes to beauty and grace. However, contrary to her image, she is on the path to becoming a thirty-something spinster with no money and no boyfriend! And on top of that, she can't even cook for herself...?! What if she could find her fated "cooking prince"?! Someone who can sympathize with her true personality!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)
synonyms: Sumire Sensei Doesn't Want to Cook

title.native: すみれ先生は料理したくない

153198.description:
Louis is a desperately poor boy struggling to survive by picking through trash. In the midst of despair, he witnessed the moment when a mysterious egg broke open...! And then strange things started happening all around the globe. A shocking new age SF drama!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

Note: Grand-prize winner of the 2020 Shonen Jump Plus Rensai Grand Prix.

153199.description:
Rokko Higashinada is a high school girl who became the chairman of the Hishaku Shopping Arcade business association. She tried her best to improve business at the desolate shopping district, but all the shopkeepers in the arcade are a little crazy. Will the Hishaku Shopping Arcade ever come back to life under such circumstances?

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

title.native: わくわくろっこモーション

153201.description:
What if a myth from 300 years ago wasn’t just a myth? According to Joseon legends, it has been told that Haechi, the youngest son of the Jade Emperor, was inseparable from the Princess So-yang. Following the recent discovery of the princess’s tomb, Lee Young-gwang is chosen to curate the exhibition. However, it seems there were more than just ruins in the tomb that was excavated… Haechi reappears in modern-day Korea to search for his princess. Will he be able to find her? And is Young-gwang ready for the adventure that awaits her, full of danger and centuries-old vengeance?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: La Légende de la Princesse Soyang

153202.description:
Do-Hui has horrible handwriting – except she doesn’t! She just hasn’t overcome her complex about the unique way she holds a pencil… not yet, anyway. When team leader Chan-Yeol Jeong takes interest in Do-Hui’s handwriting, she joins his project and they begin a professional partnership. As she begins working with Chan-Yeol, will Do-Hui be able to overcome her insecurity? And could their business relationship develop into something more?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

153203.description:
The older guy she’s had a one-way crush on for years vs. the younger guy she can’t stop thinking about… Who will she choose?
June, a political reporter at a newspaper giant, decides to quit her job after her boss turns down her idea for a gutsy and powerful political piece… ...And ends up getting a job offer from her long-time crush who also happens to hold a high position at a massive film company.
She meets the big up-and-coming actor, Tae-Oh, her first day on set and finds his attitude nothing but suspicious. June, giddy from all the time she gets to spend with her crush, Jung-Woo, finds herself blindsided by a proposal from none other than the hot actor himself!

(Source: Lezhin US)

153204.description:
Uriel will give anything to be with Rafflet Mogris, the commander of the Paladins, her savior, and... her master. For years, Uriel happily served as his maid until he left to enlist. Uriel waited for him for seven years before deciding to journey to be at his side in the capital. What the world doesn’t know is Uriel is more than just a maid. In a world riddled with monsters, she has the ability to foresee monster attacks in her dreams. If being with Rafflet means Uriel must join the fight, will her desires be enough to overcome her fears?

(Source: Tapas)

153205.description:
Want skills? Take the pills.

The day I decided to disappear from this world, I met a cat that offered me the gift of acquiring someone else's ability. I was given five magical pills that would each take off 7 years of my life. But little did I know, each pill also came with more dire consequences.

(Source: Manta)

153206.description:
Evelyn Monstera knows two things. First, she's been reborn as a mean girl in a fantasy novel, and second, if nothing changes, her cruelty to the main characters will be her undoing. So when the male lead of the novel, Casis Urquio, comes to stay at her manor, all she has to do is stay out of his way. Unfortunately, Evelyn not only causes a fight between the protagonists, but also wins the affection of the male lead too! Can Evelyn set the story straight and get the happily ever after she wants?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Seduced the Sickly Male Lead

153207.description:
After dropping out of high school, Daegun Kwon is working part-time at a convenience store while preparing to get his GED. After being harassed by a group of punks during work and teaching them a lesson, Daegun is approached by a woman from the Education Foundation about a project called “Designated Bully”. After being offered another chance at a normal life, Daegun accepts the offer and attends school to perform his one duty as the designated bully: To take down the other bullies, and restore order to the school.

(Source: WEBTOON)

They decide to get married to spite their former lovers. But as she learns more about Shuu and about cycling, Kazumi develops a deep love for both. Luckily for them, the answer to all their problems is right in front of them—in the sex toy shop Sun-Hee’s been working at! Despite being a loyal employee, Sun-Hee’s never used any of the products herself. But, desperate needs call for desperate measures. Will the two manage to salvage their relationship? 153682.description:
The world has already fallen. Remaining human survivors are oppressed under the iron rule of “zomgans” – half-human, half-zombie hybrids who evolved from a viral outbreak that wiped out human civilization. The only thing that stands between zomgans and total domination over humanity is the Eradication Front, a ragtag band of resistance fighters that includes “transcenders”, humans who possess special powers. The struggle against the undead looks hopeless, until one day they come across Mirae On, a boy who can’t die…

(Source: WEBTOON)

153683.description:
"Oh...a woman is being attacked!?" After karate practice, a boy, Subaru, hears screams in the park late at night and rushes over. When a beautiful mature woman is grabbed by the arm by a thug, he knocks him out with his signature kick. However, it was a filming for a "movie for adults" that was being done by a college student club, and Subaru was forced to take responsibility for the mess-up by the director...

Note: Published in COMIC Kuriberon DUMA 2021-11 Vol. 30

153684.description:
Do I want to live? Of course I do!

Just before she gets hit by a huge truck, Inseo Han, an ordinary South Korean woman who worked in a research lab, receives a text message offering her a special journey, new relationships, and opportunities for extra income. Determined to make it out of the situation alive, she accepts the offer and soon finds herself in the Raotwan Empire of Laseania as Duke Adrian's 12th fiancee candidate, Isella Derhen. Inseo has to act the role for an entire month in order to make it back to earth alive, but this job requires her to deceive not only a few nobles but the entire empire as well as the emperor. Not only that, but Duke Adrian demands that Inseo must never fall in love with him.

Meanwhile, Adrian, the duke and patriach of House Beleskez, is in search of an adequate fiancee to avoid a royal marriage with the emperor's third daughter, Princess Kiersten. Though things would be very simple if the princess were to marry the duke's son, Lord Aslan, political strife complicates the situation and Adrian cannot simply turn down the marriage. Hence, he seeks someone who can act as his fiancee so he would have a justified reason to avoid the royal marriage until Aslan succeeds the dukedom.

Will Inseo win the deal and the opportunity to save her life? Can she and Adrian pull off the tremendous act without getting caught?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

153685.description:
Ssamsson, a streamer with 3 million subscribers, starts live streaming in a deserted island with five other streamers. To find catchier material, the group explores the island deeper and deeper and faces an old bunker. With curiosity and fear filling the air, the ATTACK has begun!

(Source: WEBTOON)

153686.description:
Mumyung was born a medium, a human who can communicate with spirits. She tried to live a normal life according to her dead mother’s wishes, but when she comes of age, she starts attracting various spirits – including those dangerous and evil. This causes her to seek help from Heukrang the Black Wolf, a mystical creature who once aided her by guiding her mother’s spirit to the underworld. With their fateful reunion, Mumyung must soon accept that she can no longer run from her destiny…

(Source: Tapas)

153688.description:
Some people start off their possession stories on an epic journey of discovery and growth–but not the newly awakened Trixie Giuseppe. She’s not even five minutes into her novel but is already married to the biggest creep ever and disowned by her parents. Wishing to free herself from the shackles placed by her awful husband, Trixie takes a job as a servant at a remote estate. But she discovers too late that the “young master” she has to serve is the empire’s foolish prince, Leone Atarta. The novel’s author must’ve misspelled the word “feral” as Leone turns out to be much more of a beast than a simple beauty. And thus begins Trixie’s tale of trying to tame her new “dog” and make him the shining crown prince he’s meant to be.

(Source: Tappytoon)

153689.description:
Ino, an expressionless and unsociable office worker, lives with a younger man who is in love with him like a dog with its master. Even though the two of them barely know each other, Taichiro suddenly volunteers himself when Ino and his colleagues put out a drunken call for candidates to be Ino's partner. Ino turns Taichiro down, but because Taichiro has no home to go back to, Ino offers to let him live with him. Taichiro is patient, and although he sometimes can be touchy and steadfast about his love for Ino, he makes sure never to do anything that Ino won't like. One day, after starting to come to terms with his own feelings for Taichiro and his boundless devotion, Ino falls into a suspiciously deep puddle and somehow enters a parallel world. He finds Taichiro there, but in this world, the two of them are complete strangers, and Taichiro's cold demeanor seems to be almost the complete opposite of the man Ino knows and loves...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

Rieko embark on the Yamato, a probe drilling vessel, to see Ryuu, her brother working on it. Despite being docked, the Yamato suddenly starts drilling the ground more and more, without Ryuu nor his colleague being able to control it. The three of them collapse due to the temperature.

When they finally wake up, they discover that they have reached the Hollow Earth!

He's able to hide it well thanks to his suppressants, but circumstances force him to seek release with a partner. And so, Yuma is reunited with Mao, the first person who awakened him to the pleasure of pain. As soon as Mao kisses him, Yuma's knees buckle as memories of that first bite coming rushing back. He's never been commanded before...!

But, when Kiichi discovers Rei's one and only secret, the two enter a competition with Kiichi's silence at stake. What starts off as an innocent bet turns into something more, as the two feed off of each other's pleasure. A love story between the princely host and the savage host unfolds!

His name is Seed. The encounter between Seed, who has the ability to seduce the opposite sex and manipulate them to his will, and a certain Demon Cloth Princess causes further turmoil in Megalasia! With his temptation powers, corrupt the most powerful princesses!

His Japanese may be awkward, and his grasp of ordinary tasks a little weak, but he has all the combat and surveillance training of a green beret. I, the earthling "hero" of this story, crossed over into another world based on a video game and suddenly appeared in a villainous female demon's bed when I arrived. If not for the fact that I had married all the villains in the game before crossing over, I'd have been killed pretty quickly. Now, the villains keep pestering me, asking me to help them rule the world, and vying for my hand in marriage. What am I supposed to do? I'll await your answers online! It's urgent!

Transported to a kingdom in another world with her friend, Michiru finds herself in the care of the handsome knight, Cainlotte. His demeanor is as cold as ice... But it turns out he's embarrassingly sweet to the point of being overprotective!

Will there be a limit to her big-brotherly knight's fawning!? Find out in the long-awaited comicalization of this romantic comedy about an everyday girl who was just in the wrong place at the right time!

153719.description:
Nako's been summoned as a sacred figure, but she doesn't have the special powers her summoners expected to make this "other world" a better place. She's sent away to live in a detached palace with Lynn, her lady-in-waiting, until one day, she's ordered to marry an earl who's said to be the country's hero. The thing is, he's over the age of 60. However, Nako takes one look at him and instantly falls in love with his gentle, reserved nature. Although this hero is aware that he's old and doesn't have much of a future ahead, he can't stop being attracted to the bright, cheerful girl. Little does he know that he will soon wake up and find that he is back in his twenties!

(Source: Renta!)

153720.description:
Gu Yunyun, a high school student, is transported and wakes up to find that she has become a one-year-old Empress named Edith, who is in charge of a huge empire and blessed by gods. But it is no small feat be an infant monarch. Her seemingly prosperous empire is on the verge of collapse, and her own little life is in the hands of a mysterious church. On the bumpy road of ruling a country, she is approached by a boy called Crollo, whose soul seems to be something else...

(Source: Webcomics)

153721.description:
"I'm actually doing this because of you, Miss Gu."

Top actress Qu Xizhi makes an unconventional decision to take on a male lead role so she can work with Gu Xizhi, another actress who shares her name. The talented yet envious Gu Xizhi worries that Qu will once again outshine her in this new drama, but is determined to give her all to the show. Once the filming begins, Gu must shoot numerous intimate scenes with Qu, whose cross-dressing is remarkably convincing. Can Gu keep up the act, or will it lead to something more... real?

(Source: Tappytoon)

153722.description:
"As long as I'm with Risa, I don't think anyone will love me."

Ryoko Tsurugi joined the track club to avoid being jealous of her best friend Risa Ichinomiya, who was beautiful, popular, and outspoken. Ryoko had a crush on Jumonji Michitaka, a member of the club, but she was worried about how close he was with Risa and felt unsure of herself. On the other hand, Narikawa, another member of the track club, was aware of Ryoko's feelings for Jumonji, but he liked Ryoko, too... This is a coming-of-age rhapsody about the clumsy and frustrating feelings that comes and goes.

(Source: CoMax, translated)

153723.description:
Kirameku Kisetsu: Having just successfully started a new job, Ami's days are fulfilling and busy. But that didn't leave much time for her boyfriend of three years, which she didn't mind because she felt like they were in a stable relationship. Her friends asked her, "How can you even say you are lovers?"

Caramel no Coat wo Watashi ni: My boyfriend, who goes to the same university, has been acting strange recently. We don't see each other as often as we did before, and his replies to my phone calls and emails are short and curt. Apparently, he and his roommate seem to be into "older women"?

Not a day goes by in peace in the academy, and all Eun-Wu wishes for is to fix her shortcomings and return to the army. But in an age of despair where the truth is concealed, these three people are swept up in an ominous prophecy.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Single and lonely, he decides to pour his energy to work, where he meets his senior, Yukio Koda, whose charming personality had Hisashi developing a crush. The two of them make a pair in the office as the duo of luck where coincidentally, good luck came to people who come in contact with them. Their jokes and laughter would fill the classroom. But as the new school year rolls around, Fujikawa and Sasaki find themselves assigned to the same class while their friends are shuffled elsewhere. 'What exactly does that mean for Sasaki?' you ask? It means lunchtime with a perpetual food thief who takes every opportunity to take a jab at him. Every. Single. Day. It's not like they don't get along, but the two have quite the opposite energy levels... Will the calm and quiet Fujikawa and the energetic and fiery Sasaki be able to find an equilibrium? Or will being together every day push them past their boiling points?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.english: I Realize That I Am Falling in Love
title.native: 恋に気づいたその日から
title.romaji: Koi ni Kizuita Sono Hi Kara

153811.description:
Reo is a part-time store clerk. During one of his breaks, he dreamt of a fantasy world where a hero and his aide are fighting against a demon lord, wreaking havoc. The hero was making his retreat when his co- worker abruptly woke Reo. Waving it off as a product of his imagination, Reo continues with his day. Though, thoughts about the hot hero made him horny to which he plans to deal with by hooking up with someone online after his shift ends. Things didn't really happen as planned when Reo encounters the very hero he dreamt about wandering the streets of Japan. Pitying the lost and confused hero, Reo takes him home, where the hero, Adolf, implores Reo to let him stay for a while, to which Reo agrees in exchange for sex. To his surprise, Adolf consents. Now starts the love story of an average store clerk and a hero from another world.

(Source: Futekiya)

title.english: The Hero’s So OP Down There That I Don’t Know What to Do
title.native: 勇者さまのアレがチート級すぎて困ってます
title.romaji: Yuusha-sama no Are ga Cheat-kyuu Sugite Komattemasu

153812.description:
Seijiro lives alone in the old house surrounded by mountains and forests. Seijiro is a writer whose recent book has gained massive popularity. But as the novel is based on his own life with his late master, he struggles to write an anticipated sequel. How can he continue a story that has already ended...? Perhaps a walk in the woods will help clear his mind...

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

153813.description:
Haruta's a good-looking guy who always helps other people out - and it's all thanks to his power that lets him hear what's in people's hearts. Surely there can't be any better guy than him? Wrong! Meet Aoyama, Haruta's friend who outshines him in every single way. When Haruta can't listen in to what's on Aoyama's mind, how's he supposed to catch his weakness?

(Source: Futekiya)

153814.description:
When war tore Rubika from her life and her love, Armand, she thought everything was over... until she wakes up as her 22-year-old self! Though ecstatic at this second chance to reunite with her beloved, she discovers that she must now marry Duke Kleimore due to her conniving relatives' scheme. Unable to avoid the union, Rubika decides to just get the duke to divorce her instead! With a marriage to break up and a war looming in the near future, will Rubika be able to safely meet Armand once more?

(Source: Tapas)

153815.description:
Eliana, the eldest daughter of a poor aristocratic family, accepts Baron Karman's proposal for the support of her younger siblings and family, but as soon as she gets married, she hears a voice like a scoundrel. Besides, she was stigmatized as the stepmother by Sharchen's scheme.

Eliana, who could not be defeated like this, decides to actively use her stepmother's image to turn the crisis into an opportunity.

Her goal is to become the queen of the harem. It is not for sweet love, but a shortcut to gaining power like war. Can she get revenge and find true love in this dangerous harem construction?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

153816.description:
The beautiful lady, Louise, has memories from her past lives. And there are 7 peoples' worth of lives (moreover the villain’s role). Louise, who has always met the bad end of getting stabbed to death, has decided that she will live this life peacefully. However, Louise has been assigned as Prince Emile's instructor! And so, she struggles with teaching the extremely shy prince who shuts himself up in his room. In her 8th reincarnated life, she will do anything for a happy ending!

(Source: Flex Comics, translated)
synonyms: The Duke's Daughter Who Was a Villain in Her Previous Lives Was Entrusted With Training a Hikikomori Prince

That age, the opposite sex, the rebellious phase, and how to counteract them.

153824.description:
The sanctuary is exhausted after the battle against the Lord of Darkness Hades.

In the absence of Seiya and the others, the land was about to meet its end in the wrath of the goddess Nemesis!

At that moment, the Emperor of the Sea Poseidon awakens to Hades' call and, together with the Seven Marina Generals challenges Nemesis and their Heroic Souls who serve her in battle!

title.native: 聖闘士星矢 海皇再起 RERISE OF POSEIDON
title.romaji: Saint Seiya: Kaiou Saiki RERISE OF POSEIDON

153825.description:
Kou Mitsuki is a gamer with god-tier skills, known online as Crim the Headhunter. Right when he starts testing his father's latest game, Destiny Unchain Online, and the new device developed for it, the bug-ridden system transforms him in into a vampire girl! Everything changes for Kou as he meets new friends and they take on the game... The ultimate gamer adventure awaits!

(Source: K MANGA)

153827.description:
One day, our protagonist was reborn as Alicia, a blind duchess in a fantasy world. In her previous life, she was sickly and spent all her time in the hospital, so she decided to enjoy her new life as much as possible, even though she was blind! She was living her reincarnated life to the fullest, playing with Kyle, the fifth prince, whom she befriended by chance, and training in magic. However, as Alicia grew up, inexplicable events began to occur. It seems that this world was not just a happy fantasy after all......?

(Source: Regina Comics, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 1 extra chapter.

Reincarnated as the Duke's Blind Daughter

title.romaji: Moumoku no Koushaku Reijou ni Tensei shimashita

153828.description:
Hunting, cooking, and eating all kinds of magical beasts, the world is truly in a great age of cooking! It has been more than three hundred years since the birth of the "hunter-ruler," a fusion of the concepts of hunting and cooking. Ren, once a promising young man from a family of heroes, is now branded as a useless person for one reason or another, and by chance he befriended Lucy, a girl who aspired to become the world's best hunter and chef. She was a student at the prestigious Kruel Academy of Monster and Beast Science, and despite her earnest nature, she was ridiculed as a failure because of the enormous amount of magical power that she couldn't control. One day, Lucy learned of her partner's tragic past, and she began to develop her talents under Len's guidance. This is the world's most delicious tale of a hero spun between a boy and a girl.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 英雄失格者の魔獣グルメ

153829.description: One day every human on the world suddenly receives a mail claiming to enact the World Salvation Project. Half in doubt Kurosaki Shion, a diligent university student and loner, follows the mail’s instructions, becoming one of a million Demon Kings governing his very own Domain in the new world.
synonyms: Dungeon Battle Royale ~ Since I Became a Demon King, I Will Aim for World Domination ~

title.native: ダンジョンバトルロワイヤル 〜魔王になったので世界統一を目指します〜
title.romaji: Dungeon Battle Royale: Maou ni Natta node Sekai Touitsu wo Mezashimasu

153830.description:
One day everyone on earth suddenly receives a mysterious survey email. The mail states that the world salvation project has begun and that everyone will be divided into LAW, CHAOS and NEUTRAL. Shion Kurosaki, a loner freshman in university, was sorted into CHAOS. Which means that in the new world he is to be a Demon Lord who needs to prepare his dungeon, fill it with monsters and fend off the attacks from the LAW heroes. A dungeon building adventure begins!

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: Dungeon Battle Royale ~ Since I Became a Demon King, I Will Aim for World Domination ~

title.romaji: Dungeon Battle Royale: Maou ni Natta node Sekai Touitsu wo Mezashimasu

153831.description:
A Japanese girl was reincarnated as Alicia, a blind duchess in a fantasy world. In her previous life, she was sickly and spent most of her life in bed, so in this life, she decided to enjoy herself as much as possible. She played outside as much as she could, trained in magic, and lived life to the fullest. The years passed, and one day, when Alicia turned 16, she met a girl. She seemed cheerful and friendly, but then the she asked, "Alicia-sama, isn't it about time for us to move on with the story?"

(Source: Alphapolis, translated)
synonyms: I was reincarnated as a blind duke's daughter

153832.description:
It can be hard to be a member of the swim team with such large breasts getting in the way. Even choosing the right outfit is a challenge. Thankfully, the coach has some perfect ideas on what to do, and Saya's teammates are only too happy to help!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Natsumi was looking forward to a lovey-dovey summer with her boyfriend. But after finding out he's stuck making up bad test grades all summer, she agrees to go to the beach with her friend Makoto. Little does she know that Makoto is a total slut who only wanted to bring Natsumi to her insatiable fuckbuddies...

(Source: Irodori Comics)

153839.description:
College student Juwon has a hot girlfriend and everything else a guy could ask for. But when his childhood best friend cum first love, Nahee, moves into his boarding house and joins his college after years of no contact, Juwon finds himself in a sticky situation. Especially when she brings up the promise he made to her as a teenager: to let her, an aspiring artist, draw his hard on. Of course, Juwon tries to refuse, but Nahee is not one to be swayed by reason, and a man can hardly go back on his word, right? But things soon start getting stickier before Juwon realizes what’s happening…

(Source: Lezhin X)
synonyms: 自己中なカノジョ～初恋の呪い～

153842.description:
The Alexander Institute was a private Catholic school in Switzerland, where Angel Winter resided after losing her parents. She became fascinated by a girl named Lilibeth, who had just arrived at the school. Lilibeth was not only beautiful, but she also looked just like the girl that appeared in Angel's frequent nightmares. Soon after, a series of strange incidents occurred at the academy. Agatha, Angel's roommate, went into a coma, and another girl named Mary died a mysterious death. Angel also suffered a strange hallucination and collapsed, but Lilibeth visited her and comforted her by inviting Angel to come to her bed and "be together" with her. However, when Dr. Callard discovered that Lilibeth was a vampire, Angel was forcibly taken out of the school and sent to her grandfather's home in Austria. Angel's grandfather, the doctor, and the priest will try to prevent Lilibeth from making Angel her successor.

Table Of Contents:
1-5. Hana no you na Lilibeth (花のようなリリベット); Shuukan Shoujo Friend, 1973#50 - 1974#02;
6. Aozameta Dionne (青ざめたディオンヌ); Gekkan Seventeen, 1973-09;
7. Mizumo no Yurikago (水藻のゆりかご); Shuukan Margaret, 1973-36.

Mizumo no Yurikago (水藻のゆりかご)

153844.description:
Takaki Kozuki is a seasoned software coder who's afraid to take chances. Yuichiro Kunieda is good-looking, half-Caucasian, and super-serious. He's introduced to Takaki as a new addition to the planning department and they start working together. Contrary to his lovable looks, Yuichiro doesn't make friends easily because of his excessively square ways, but for some reason, he's taken to Takaki. Takaki is also fond of the younger man for his sincere attitude. One day, they go out drinking with colleagues, and Yuichiro gets terribly drunk. He leans in and kisses Takaki before he can figure out what's happening...

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Yuichiro Wants to be Special to Takaki
title.native: 国枝くんは上月さんの特別になりたい
title.romaji: Kunieda-kun wa Kouduki-san no Tokubetsu ni Naritai

153846.description:
"Can you not learn to love me?"

Seishiro Kyogoku, son and personal secretary of the incumbent Minister of Justice, is now living the newlywed life with his just-for-show husband Takeru Kyogoku and his young half-brother Reo. However, being the honest and diligent man he is, Seishiro can't shake his guilt over dragging them all into this farce of a marriage. Despite his best intentions, he grows more and more despondent as time passes. That's when Takeru tells him not to worry because everything will turn out fine if they just turn their sham marriage into a real one...... How exactly is love born?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The Wedding Night of Kyogoku Family

153847.description:
When Yae was in high school, she met a Shinto priest, Oda, when she transferred to a new school, and after some twists and turns, they fell in love. Yae decided that she wanted to become a Shinto priest herself, and entered university to study for the job. Even though they have touched each other in intimate ways, they have not yet gone all the way. Yae was excited about what might happen now that she's in college, but he still showed no signs of making a move on her...?

In this sequel to If Given A Second Chance, the storyline will be more mature, a bit sexier, and a lot more loving. You'll read it and fall in love, too!

(Source: BookWalker, translated)

title.native: 次はさせてね　はじめて

153848.description:
Ever since Helga Yutrit found out that she was switched at birth with her half-sister, she has tried her best to shake off the stigma of being a fake by building up her reputation as the perfect daughter of House Yutrit. Helga's efforts all go to waste, though, when her half-sister Hillianne is discovered alive. Now that the real daughter has returned to take her rightful place, Helga is plotting her revenge on the family that never appreciated her and the half-sister who is stealing her life.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ลูกสาวตัวจริงกลับมาแล้ว

153849.description:
Sakamoto, an ordinary college student, becomes friends with a beautiful girl he met at his part-time job, Mari Himeya, through a competitive game, and on holidays they play against each other in his room. One day, however, Mari wore mini-skirted knee-socks. Sakamoto, a big fan of mini-skirts and knee-socks, couldn't help but notice Mari's lower half. As the game heats up, Mari lets her guard down and shows her panties all over the place. Can Sakamoto really hold back his sexual desire for his friend? Of course not!

Note: As a setting, it is treated as a prequel of Isekai AV Satsueitai. The heroine's name may be different, but if you look closely at chapter 4 of Isekai AV Satsueitai, her real name Mari appears at the bottom of her Career Survey.
synonyms: Smashing With Your Gamer Girl Friend

title.native: ゲーム友達の女の子とヤる話
title.romaji: Game Tomodachi no Onnanoko to Yaru Hanashi

153850.description:
Will the relationship between Sakamoto and Himeiya go the next step after their Hot Spring trip?

(Source: FAKKU!)

title.english: Getting it On With Your Gaming Buddy at the Hot Spring
title.native: ゲーム友達の女の子と温泉旅行でヤる話
title.romaji: Game Tomodachi no Onnanoko to Onsen Ryokou de Yaru Hanashi

153851.description:
What if... Sakamoto hadn't step into the scene where Mari was taking a mixed bath with a group of strangers?

Mari Himeya goes on a lovey-dovey hot spring trip alone with her game-loving boyfriend. However, her boyfriend becomes obsessed with the retro games at the hotel and leaves Mari alone. Unknowingly, she is picked up by two burly college rugby players... Can these rugby players, with their voracious sexual appetites, resist the temptation to show each other off? Can Mari keep her fidelity to her boyfriend?

Note: Follows the opposite development from the lovemaking version.

title.native: ゲーム友達の女の子と温泉旅行でヤる話NTRver.
title.romaji: Game Tomodachi no Onnanoko to Onsen Ryokou de Yaru Hanashi NTRver.

153852.description:
One day, a high school girl suddenly came to my door and said she wanted to return a favor! When I asked her why, she told me that she was the crow that I had saved before. I let her in, still wondering about what was going on, but she turned out to be so clumsy that I had to save her again...!? A slapstick love comedy that began with a favor that must be repaid!!!

(Source: BookWalker, translated)
synonyms: The crow I saved that one time, is just too clumsy for me

title.native: あの時助けたカラスがドジすぎて困る
title.romaji: Ano Toki Tasuketa Karasu ga Doji Sugite Komaru

153853.description:
Hildea Hillington, the daughter of duke Hillington, always knew that she was a mere supporting role in the story. She also knew that her destiny was to watch her younger sister, Roserielle, get married to young and ambitious duke Gabriel Velkius.
But something was definitely off. Why does Gabriel say that he loves me? He's supposed to be in love with my sister!

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: 脇役令嬢とヒロインの妹

title.english: The Fabulous Lives of the Hillington Sisters

153855.description:
At 27, I should be enjoying sweet, carefree relationships. But ever since my shocking first time with my first boyfriend at 20, I haven't been able to date anyone else. Why? Because size does matter. And because of this, I've coldly rejected even the obvious advances of one of my coworkers. Then one day, I stumbled into his lap—literally—and my hand accidentally brushed his thigh. And there it was. Something long and firm...like a baguette? I'm serious. It’s not about his loaded family. It’s about what’s in between his legs! Could there be more to the guy I turned down than meets the eye? A daringly sweet and spicy office romance begins with "Going the Extra Inch."

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes ten extra chapters.
synonyms: 淫らなバゲットに恋して

153856.description:
Emperor Exceltrion brought the world to destruction with his cruel anger. Of all people, I became that emperor!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: This is a one shot prologue for the web novel of the same name.

title.english: They Formed a Circle, But Not to Dance
title.native: 輪になっても踊れない

153860.description:
My name is Ha-Yun Lee, and I'm an ordinary college student. I decided to go on a spontaneous trip before school resumed and met this guy named Kang-On. He asked me out on the first day we met, but of course, I rejected him. I thought I'd never see him again, but guess what? I ran into him during the school club recruitment event! And wait… What? Even Ji-Il, the president of the student club "You," also has a crush on me?! I swear I'm not delulu. I swear!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Includes four side story chapters.

title.english: This is a Campus Romance Series

153861.description:
Yasuda Ippei is the son of Yasuda Seijiro, the head of Yasuda Group, Japan's biggest business conglomerate. Although he is the son of a distinguished family, he has absolutely no disagreeable areas and is liked by everyone.

His academic achievements are exceptional. He completed his entire high school programme in 2 years and qualified for Tokyo University's Faculty of Law without studying for the exams. In order to establish his own concept of justice, Yasuda leaves his position as the heir to the Yasuda Group to attend the police academy. He becomes a detective at Kyobashi Police Precinct and bravely faces great evil.

(Source: DramaWiki)

153862.description:
A harem inside a shoddy apartment!?

(Source: FAKKU)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten BEAST 2018-10

153863.description:
Come play with a juicy kogal! ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten BEAST 2021-07

153864.description:
I won't let you find happiness!!

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2016-03

153865.description:
Save the other world? My opponent is… those from my world?

“Everyone, from here on, you will be sent to another world.” With those words from a goddess, Michinaga alighted in another world. He possesses three thieving-type skills. Relying on those skills and while meeting people who have the odd quirk or two, he starts working towards saving the world.

What is the true meaning behind the goddess’ words? Three hints: “save the world”, “capture dungeons” and “your opponents are those from your world”.

title.native: 救わなきゃダメですか? 異世界

153866.description:
In Minami, Osaka, there’s a convenience store that has some seriously strange customers coming through the late shift. But the customers aren’t the only ones out of place here—the late-night shift is full of weirdos! And for the arrogant demon Aruru, she’s responsible for keeping up with every oddity that walks through the door. It may be a pain, but she’s determined to do her best!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Workin' on a Night Shift at Akumart

title.english: Workin' the Night Shift at Akumart
title.native: コンビニ夜勤のあくまちゃん

153867.description:
Riddled with student loans and debt, Han Jungwoo is dead broke. When he loses all hope of finding a proper job, Jungwoo agrees to participate in a clinical trial and swallows AF-12, a pill that gives him knowledge about chemistry and the ability to see chemical particles. The company that made AF-12 even offers to hire him for a large sum of money... if he can keep his condition a secret. With this last chance to turn his life around, will Jungwoo accept the offer despite the challenges?

(Source: Tapas)

153869.description:
Earth had been invaded by creatures from another dimension, and it has been a few years since peace was restored, thanks to the help of various supernatural humans that revealed themselves during this invasion. Gwangik Yu, our protagonist, was born between two supernatural parents. His father is an immortal while his mother is a transformer with exceptional physical abilities along with the power to transform into beasts. Neither parent, however, is aware of each spouse’s power and both want Gwangik to follow in their footsteps.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: อัจฉริยะนอกคอก

153870.description:
In the near future, the full-dive Virtual Reality technology will be commonly utilized in daily life.

Mitsuki Kou is enlisted by his father, the developer of the new VRMMORPG “Destiny Unchain Online,” which features a skill system that prioritizes player abilities and Player versus Player over leveling, to test a revolutionary human interface device on the game’s release day.

However, he inexplicably finds himself transformed into a vampire girl and trapped in the game with no means of logging out. Moreover, he ends up in a remote forest due to a malfunction.

Despite being reassured by his father that he is not in any immediate danger, Kou decides to immerse himself in the game and make the most of his experience. He hones his skills, forms a guild, and inadvertently attracts attention by role-playing as a “Wizened Loli” character, captivating viewers with his streaming sessions. Soon, Kou becomes well-known as the “Scarlet Demon Lord,” Crim-Luersheia.

But what impact will Kou’s prolonged exposure to the game have on his physical body in reality?

title.native: Destiny Unchain Online　～吸血鬼少女となって、やがて『赤の魔王』と呼ばれるようになりました～
title.romaji: Destiny Unchain Online: Kyuuketsuki Shoujo to Natte, Yagate "Aka no Maou" to Yobareru You ni Narimashita

Akuma de JK!: Makai Appli de Harem Shiken

153873.description:
Life can be so much harder than you imagine.
The fear of an unknown future can feel like falling into the abyss.
As Lin Rufan neared graduation, those feelings of frustration, guilt, and helplessness were threatening to consume her. But then a small miracle granted her the courage to face life head-on.

(Source: Dongman, translated)

153874.description:
Like the children of other prominent families, Sia Cha (Alpha), the second daughter of the SW group, became engaged in an arranged marriage at an early age. In order to increase their genetic compatibility and get used to her pheromones, she was placed with her fiancée and his family since childhood. But her fiancee found his true love and asked her for a breakup. After that rejection, she suffered from omega pheromone intolerance for the next several years. That day too, she tried to get away from a party and take her rest, when a stranger approached her...

"I want a child with you, no strings attached. Just give me one night!"

For the first time since her breakup, an Omega appeared whose scent did not trigger her disgust.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

153876.description:
Who knew dating could be so hairy?

After waking up from a night of drinking, Yeon-Hui is shocked to find herself in the bed of the hottest guy at school, Saeksi An! And apparently she gave him a Brazilian wax?! Saeksi gives her an ultimatum — tell everyone they slept together and start dating, or he'll reveal their hairy business!

(Source: Manta, edited)

153877.description:
An ex-Kpop fan moves to Japan.

For Baek-Hui, who lives in a broken household with a cheating father and a depressed mother, fangirling over the popular K-pop star Tinkerbell was her only solace. But when she realizes that the image of Tinkerbell she had loved for so long was only a fantasy, Baek-Hui decides it’s time to live for herself, and suddenly moves to Japan. What adventures will she embark upon in her new life?

(Source: Manta, edited)

153878.description:
He suddenly looks like a snack!

Just dumped, Eva turns to the comfort of food to heal her broken heart. But little does she know that her childhood friend, James, may just be the comfort she needs! Can James help Eva cook up a cure for heartbreak? Or will it be a recipe for disaster?

(Source: Manta)

153879.description:
A cute and charming story about a unique relationship between the demonic protagonist and the saintly heroine who seduces the demon!

(Source: Shonen Gangan, translated)

title.native: 汝の敵から誘惑されることなかれ
title.romaji: Nanji no Teki kara Yuuwakusareru Koto Nakare

153880.description:
Despite having only one arm, Daven had finally proven his worth after defeating his cousin Kazin in honorable combat. But Kazin took advantage of Daven’s mercy, stabbing him in the back and imprisoning him for life. 500 years later, the minor god Yulian is reborn and unknowingly summons Daven’s soul into the body of a young boy named Vincent Adenka. As the pair work to reveal the truth of Daven and Kazin, Vincent must relearn the art of combat while Yulian discovers the art of reincarnation.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: สูตรสำเร็จแห่งการเกิดใหม่

title.native: 千年戦争後の魔族たち～エンドロールジャーニー～
title.romaji: Sennen Sensougo no Mazokutachi: Endroll Journey

153883.description:
What would you do with the chance to become far greater than your greatest rivals… before they could even start? When a dominant guild gangs up on Rokan to humiliate him and destroy his hard-earned achievements in the world's most realistic fantasy VR game, he becomes desperate for revenge. But just when Rokan thinks he's lost it all, a twist in space-time sends him back to right before the game is even launched. Now, this former SSS-ranker sees the perfect opportunity to return to glory!

(Source: Tapas)

153885.description:
A young man delivers food to the same house every day. However, the young woman who picks up the food starts wearing skimpy clothes day after day...

"Is she trying to seduce me?"

(Source: DAYcomics)

153886.description:
Yukino was raised by her loving single father, but she's been dating his coworker behind his back! Daddy has no idea how naughty his daughter can be! ❤︎

(Source: Irodori Comics)
