153893.description:
Chemistry teacher Ran is tasked with looking after the class problem child, Chiaki, with one-on-one supplementary lessons in order to prevent Chiaki from repeating a year.

In order to make Chiaki, who has zero interest in science, take the supplementary lessons, with Ran's proposal of "Cooking"...?

title.native: ヤンキー君と科学ごはん

153895.description: There is a mountain lodge in the Tokusheng mountain range run by three sisters called "Unkai Hut." Visitors come to the mountain lodge for a variety of reasons...

title.native: やまさん ~山小屋三姉妹~

153896.description:
Katagiri Jinpachi is a man plagued by mysteries, and the only one who can help him is the mysterious Harada Oriza, a famed painter of ghost and yokai portraits. These two men share the same peculiar fate, and their wicked tale of the ghastly and the curious, the strange and the shocking, all begins here.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: Tales of the Hundred Monsters Next Door

153897.description:
Gayan was a villain whose task was to sharpen the male leads, molding them into the suitable protagonists. However, the protagonists he encountered had various quirks, and none of them showed the slightest desire to aim high. They remained indifferent even when Gayan walked all over them. Gayan had no choice but to change his approach. He worked tirelessly to gain the protagonists' trust and affection, only to betray them afterward. Gayan plotted various schemes such as stabbing the protagonists, trapping them, and more. As expected, the protagonists grew and became supreme heroes clad with immense powers. Gayan was very satisfied as none of them could take revenge on him. He would then move on to the next world upon completing his quest as a villain. All was well until the day Gayan completed every last quest.

It was then the system spoke to him, “Your quest will only be deemed completed when you’ve returned to every single world you had ever set foot on and survive for a decade.” Gayan turned quiet before saying, “Run that by me again,” to which the system replied, “You are to return to every single world you’ve completed quests and stay alive for ten years.” Gayan, "&#￥#￥#!"

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

153898.description:
The Murim’s public enemy, the Slaughterer Demon Monarch, Yeom Se-Ak! It’s been a hundred years since he was trapped in Mount Hua after being captured by the Sword God, Han Ho. He waited all these years for his chance to seek revenge…

The long period of time caused this incident to be forgotten by the world, and eventually, even the Yeom Se-Ak was forgotten. However...

“Sir, what is your name…?”
A coincidental meeting, and the name of an archenemy that he said unwittingly, “H-Han Ho.”

At the end of a vain journey, an unexpected path branches out. The ultimate demon that’s in Mount Hua, Yeom Se-Ak’s choice!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

153899.description:
Writer Mitsuru Hasegawa and Annaka Yuusei (a.k.a. Anna), who runs a real estate business, are childhood friends and lovers. They have a secret: Anna is a "biter" who feeds on human blood, and Mitsuru is a "nectar" whose blood the "biter" likes. The two signed a "symbiotic contract" in which they could not live without each other's blood. Anna, who had a crush on Mitsuru since he was young, was as happy as having his dream come true. However, at the same time, Anna also felt guilty for what he did to Mitsuru...

(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: スモーキーネクター Renew

153900.description:
“I will become a demon.”

A young man with a dark past, known in Murim as Won-Su. After living a life without an identity, he feels remorseful. He finds a lover, which he thinks must have been fate. After losing his mother, he escapes Jungwon, but gets caught up in Murim and ends up losing his wife. Even so, he grows older alone, without getting involved...

(Source: Mootoon, translated)

title.native: 理由は不明だがえっちしてくれる後輩
title.romaji: Riyuu wa Fumei daga Ecchi Shite Kureru Kouhai

153902.description: Aiwa is a hormonal young man who just wants to have a girlfriend and get laid. Perpetually daydreaming about his pretty schoolmate Kozue, Aiwa wastes no time in trying to win her affection. But one day, a mysterious package arrives at Aiwa's doorstep. It seems Aiwa is finally getting his mail order from some months ago -- a cute android girl who's supposed to do whatever he asks! Now this will definitely mess up his plans for Kozue, but then having his very own cutie at home sure is convenient... what's a guy to do then?

153903.description:
After finding out his wife's and daughter's safety is at risk, former secret agent, Min goes on a mission to save his family. But he only has a matter of time before Baekdu Mountain erupts.

(Source: Tapas)

153904.description: The female protagonist, Miyu, is your typical golddigger girl - she hooks up with guys, milk them for all they're worth, then dump them and move on to her next prey. Yuuki-kun, her latest target, seems to just be your typical nice guy that genuinely looks out for Miyu, completely oblivious of her intentions. However, something's different about him that makes Miyu unable to carry on her usual scheme...
synonyms: Dating the kind of Girl you Shouldn't Get Involved With
A Dangerous Type Became My Girlfriend

title.native: かかかの ~関わってはいけないタイプの娘が彼女になった~
title.romaji: Kaka Kano: Kakawatte wa Ikenai Type no Musume ga Kanojo ni Natta

synonyms: やりすぎた魔神殲滅者の七大罪遊戯〈ニューゲーム〉

title.native: やりすぎた魔神殲滅者の七大罪遊戯
title.romaji: Yarisugita Majin Senmetsusha no New Game

153907.description: A stern novelist lost his beloved wife. But cooking the recipes she left behind gives him the energy to go on living.

153908.description:
Mitsuki's troubled. His friend since childhood, Minoru, is stuck to him like glue every moment of the day, be it at lunch break, when he's taking a bath, or when he's sleeping. There's no way this isn't weird...!! To top it all off, he finds out that his friend has a trauma after he brings him to a mixer...!! Minoru asks him to help him practice to fix it, which somehow leads to Mitsuki having his tip rubbed in the restroom while his friend calls his name in a feverish voice. "We're best friends, right...?" Read the romantic comedy between an overly-attached top and and oblivious bottom!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: My Childhood Friend Is an Obsessed Love Monster!

title.english: My Childhood Friend's an Overly-Attached Love Monster!
title.native: 幼馴染みは執着ラブモンスター！

153911.description:
Hirune Hanamaki, an employee of an exploitative company, receives a divine blessing from a goddess and is reborn in another world. Now, she lives as a golden-haired girl named Hirune. Refusing to work tirelessly as she did in her past life, she decides to become a great saint and live a relaxed lifestyle. Thus begins the legend of the sleepy great saint, known for her casual and slow-paced life!

(Source: K MANGA)
synonyms: The Great Saint's Carefree Journey to Another World

title.english: The Casual Chronicles of a Great Saint
title.native: 転生大聖女の異世界のんびり紀行
title.romaji: Tensei Daiseijo no Isekai Nonbiri Kikou

153912.description:
Even though Ibuki was beautiful, people called her a "difficult girl" because she never shows any emotion. Her new boyfriend dumped her after just a month, saying "It's no fun to be with you." One day, she witnessed the transfer student, Hoshino-kun, plugging in his body to recharge! He told her that he was an "AI," and in exchange for her silence, he promised her that he would provide Ibuki with the "sweet love" that she always wanted...!? A strange, forbidden love story between an AI and a human begins.

(Source: Dessert Blue, translated)

153913.description:
A beautiful princess escaped the rebel army on her home planet and fell to Earth, where she met the Japanese boy Hanamoto Musashi, who will bravely fight to protect her in a mecha-samurai armor suit. The climactic battle is a sci-fi retelling of the famous duel of Ganryujima.

(Source: Mangapedia, translated, edited)

153914.description:
This is a complicated yet innocent love story that started from a reunion!!!

Soetani Udzuki, whose pet theory is that "All handsome men have a hidden dark side", is a contract worker who lives a modest yet peaceful life with her pet cat, Jujumaru.

Recently, to better protect her life with Jujumaru, Udzuki accepted her company's offer to make her a permanent employee. But the workload turned out to be harder than she imagined and one day, Jujumaru even fell sick. When she had to choose between her job and her cat, that's when the man next door called out to her. He turned out to be Yamada Aki, the man she couldn't forget even if she wanted to.

Since then, Aki has constantly tried to concern himself with her but Udzuki has sworn to herself to not involve herself with him...

Note: Total chapter count based on Mecha Comic priority release, which breaks each story chapter into two parts.

title.native: となりの秋とは関わらない
title.romaji: Tonari no Aki to wa Kakawaranai

153915.description:
The manga's story begins when Emma, a 30-year-old woman, loses her love life, job, and home in one fell swoop, as the boyfriend she was living with breaks up with her on the same day the company she was working for goes bankrupt. She wanders into a mansion, and is soon found by its owner Chloe, an eccentric rich heiress who lives alone. While Chloe initially accepts Emma staying at her mansion for a night, an unfortunate fire at Chloe's home that night forces them to find a living situation together. Later, a customer arrives at Chloe's fortune telling shop and brings mysterious circumstances that the two get drawn into.

(Source: Anime News Network)

153916.description:
A comforting Christmas story about the twins Mamoru and Takeru. Mamoru is considered the "good boy", the one who does his best to meet the expectations of his parents and loved ones, while Takeru takes life as it comes...

(Source: Black Box Editions, translated)

title.native: さよならサンタクロース

153918.description:
Ji-Un is infatuated with the enigmatic Se-Jin, confessing his love daily despite constant rejection. Se-Jin, on the other hand, believes Ji-Un could never truly like him for who he is. However, when Ji-Un vows to stay by Se-Jin’s side no matter what, the two decide to officially go steady. As their romance blossoms, Ji-Un is elated…but he soon discovers Se-Jin's hidden, sadistic tendencies. And things only get more complicated, as it comes to light that Ji-Un's best friend In-Hyuk has been harboring feelings for him all this time! Will Ji-Un be able to accept Se-Jin for who he is and learn to love his lusty lover? Or will Se-Jin’s lechery leave him longing for his bestie's embrace?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

153919.description:
Eun-Hyeon has a special ability to talk to animals and thus has a job as a animal comunicator. One day, a man a a dog comes to him. The man says "We will see each other often. See you next time." And as promised, the man becomes a daily customer. The love story about a man and a dog, and Eun-Hyeon who has to choose between them.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

153920.description:
On New Year's Eve, Phoenix Wright and Maya Fey, along with Gumshoe and the judge, are invited by Avery Richman to ride the maiden voyage of the Silver Star express train. During the voyage, Gumshoe spots a strange soul outside before Richman, a fugitive who was sentenced to death, takes over the train with his staff. Believing that he was wrongly declared guilty in an American court, Richman reveals he had invited all the witnesses to that case in order to hold a fair retrial, with Phoenix as his defense and Tristan Turnbull as the prosecutor. Gumshoe attempts to rescue them, only to discover the dining car that everyone is in has seemingly vanished from the train.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.native: 逆転裁判～その「真実」、異議あり！～逆転特急、北へ
title.romaji: Gyakuten Saiban: Sono "Shinjitsu", Igi Ari - Gyakuten Tokkyuu, Kita e

153921.description:
A boarding house that is full of women. A man entered a boarding house where only women lived. What will happen?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: ヤれちゃう下宿屋～男の住人はまさか僕だけ!?～

153926.description:
An accidental deal with the devil goes awry.

Veterinary student Yoon Ha discovers he has a fear of blood! To solve his problem, he makes a deal with the demon Samael in exchange for his soul, which goes terribly wrong. Now Yoon must help Samael recover his demonic powers... but evil spirits keep showing up, lusting after Yoon's body?!

(Source: Manta)

153928.description:
Jihun Min is a diligent and honest medical sales representative who is trying to make a name for himself in a company that is rampant with nepotism. Hence, he is constantly being outshined by his general manager’s nephew, Junseong Choi, who monopolizes sales performance through lobbying and shady tactics. One day, Jihun is blessed with a special ability that could propel him forward in his career. Things are finally going his way and he’s feeling more optimistic than ever, but will Jihun be able to maintain his strong moral compass and not lose sight of what truly matters?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: The Genius Sales Person: Mind Reader

153929.description:
Rosalyn poured her heart and soul into her family's business, making it the wealthiest trading company in the empire... but her ungrateful father refuses to let her inherit it! Instead, he pawns her off to the bankrupt royal family, offering her hand in marriage to Prince Robien and even agreeing to settle their debts in exchange for a noble title. Now, Rosalyn is hell-bent on leveraging her new status to take over her family's business. But life at the palace is cruel. Hated by the people and the queen for her commoner status, Rosalyn can't trust a single person to help her. And yet, Robien continues to rescue Rosalyn when she needs it most. Despite her wariness to rely on him, she can't help but confide in him as time goes on. Can she truly count on Robien to help her reclaim what is rightfully hers?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes 9 side-story chapters.
synonyms: 我與皇太子的婚姻交易
绽放的逆袭之花罗婕琳
โรซาลิน โวการ์ต
ロザリン・ボガート～復讐の王太子妃～

title.native: 私、また犯されにきました

1. Konna Ii Koto. (こんなイイコト。)
2. Konna Ii Koto. Ni (こんなイイコト。に); Comiket 99
3. Konna Ii Koto. San (こんなイイコト。さん); Comiket 100
4. Konna Ii Koto. Yon (こんなイイコト。よん); Comiket 102
5. Konna Ii Koto. Go (こんなイイコト。ご); Comiket 103
6. Konna Ii Koto. Roku (こんなイイコト。ろく); Comiket 104

153935.description:
Lactose Lady is the talk of the town! What a surprise to see the top girl in the hierarchy at school, Shinharu Aoki! I used to shag her every day in my imagination, and now I have her big tits right in front of me! I want to suck them all up! I want to drink it up! I want to impregnate her!

(Source: Fanza, translated)

Note: Released at Comic Market 100

title.native: おっぱい足りてますか?

153936.description:
After three years of trying, Bai Xiaochun sets off to start his journey to immortality. As a disciple in the Stove Room, a single grain of rice helps him towards his quest of eternal life. With his determination to stave off death, will he be able to attain strength and live long?

(Source: INKR)

153937.description:
Zhang Buzheng, an unemployed slacker, was chosen by the gods and given the chance to escape his ordinary life and become an immortal. If he could climb to the top of the tower, he would become the Lazy God! Unfortunately, his teammates for the Tower Of God were all half-wits. In order not to be cut down on his road towards immortality, Zhang Buzheng will have to become a vengeful god and face the difficult challenges head-on!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Bu Xiao Xin Juan Cheng Le Shen

153938.description:
Do they exist? Or not? Please open the door and come into the "PC Cafe," a place where everyone's hearts and minds are free to roam. A total of 35 stories are included. Please enjoy Eiko Mutsu's longest-running serialization in full color.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

153939.description:
A story about girls who want to wear their favorite clothes.
Winner of the 16th MangaOne New Monthly Award.

(Source: Author's Pixiv, translated)

153940.description: A story about a man named "B".

title.native: B ブルースの河をさかのぼりハメットに至る
title.romaji: B: Blues no Kawa wo Saka no Bori Hammet ni Itaru

153941.description:
My mom is a 45-year old former model who works hard and plays hard, which is cool with me. But is it really okay for mom to have a boyfriend who's 18 years younger than her? He's the same age as me! Features the title story and four other gems!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: ママの恋人 陸奥A子名作集
title.romaji: Mama no Koibito: Mutsu A-ko Meisakushuu

153942.description:
As the #1 stalker of Pope Ulysses, the kind male lead, Yoidel was to be executed for her crimes. Just minutes before her end, Yoidel escapes her cell to ask Ulysses for help, only to come across a bloody madman... who turns out to be the male lead himself! In a desperate attempt to survive, Yoidel binds herself to him in a magical contract, dooming the two to share their lives and deaths. Now stuck with a two-faced psycho, will Yoidel find a way to break their bond before it breaks her?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: If You Remove the Kind Protagonist’s Mask

153944.description:
When Yiren catches her fiancé and her crafty sister Rielle kissing, something in her snaps. She decides she must get married in order to escape her family. Yiren happens to learn that the icy, aloof Noel Cristan is looking for a bride in order to inherit his father's title of archduke. They agree to an arranged marriage to get what they both want, but it turns out Noel isn't the only one after his father's title. With all the family drama and intrigue, will Noel's family be any safer for Yiren?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Kind Older Sister Is No More
ไม่มีอีกแล้ว พี่สาวผู้แสนดี

153948.description:

In a single night, a high-ranking succubus named Lizbeth stole the throne of the Demon King and gained the highest level in all the world, becoming its new ruler. The enslaved males of the realm have been reduced to nothing more than cattle, doomed to have their lifeforce siphoned by the Queen and her kin to grow the already massive strength of her army. Alas, heavy is the head that wears the crown and with no challenges, Lizbeth the Demon Queen has grown weary and bored. When an elven servant tells of a legend where her race was driven to the brink of extinction by a terrifying foe, it sounds like something that can give Lizbeth the entertainment she seeks. 153975.description:
Imprisoned for years, Princess Aristine hides her true nature and that she possesses the Emperor's Eye—a skill to see past, present, and future that the emperor of Silvanus covets. Finally, her chance to escape comes when her father sends her to Ilugo, Silvanus' enemy nation, as a scapegoat to incite war under the guise of an arranged marriage to Ilugo's second prince, a known barbarian. Now ready to take the reins to her life, will Aristine be able to make money to support her freedom?

(Source: Tapas)

153983.description:
The Etruscan Kingdom is stained with blood when the king’s illegitimate son Cesare conspires with his fiancée Ariadne to usurp the throne from his half-brother Alfonso. Despite Ariadne’s devotion to the new king, her faith is shattered when she is betrayed by him and eventually murdered by her own sister, who wishes to be queen. To her surprise, Ariadne finds herself sent back in time to her 17-year-old self. As she navigates the perils and opportunities of palace intrigue, Ariadne must make the most of her guile and grit to ensure that her tragic future does not repeat itself.

(Source: WEBTOON)

153987.description:
Lee Jain has existed on Earth for 3.5 billion years, dying and being reborn as countless animal species. Now in his final life, he is reborn in South Korea as a human, his most hated species. Having inherited all the animal superpowers from his past lives, Jain is determined to survive and wipe out humanity. But when a sudden car accident erases his memory, Jain crosses paths with new beings that force the question: is humanity worth saving, or is it bound for extinction?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

153989.description:
Eight-year old Mari meets a mysterious girl named Michika in a bamboo grove during the summer.

Michika, who seems to live by different rules than normal people, inadvertently takes something very important away from Mari's classmate and bully, Ishizaki.

Feeling responsible, Michika invites Mari to step into a world beyond words, where understanding takes a different form.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

153991.description:
Aslaug is the daughter of dragon-slayer Sigurd and valkyrie Brynhild. She long slept under the great harp of magical silver, and what awaited her upon her awakening was a world of men without gods. The Scandinavian Peninsula of the 9th Century. There she had a fateful encounter with Ragnar, young warrior of the vikings, the bold men who claim to serve the disappeared Norse gods and to be braves deserving of guidance to Valhalla.
This truly was the chance meeting between the last Valkyrie and the last Einherjar.

153994.description:
The world discovered the essence of the human soul, Ideia, and found a way to materialize it. The stronger one's Ideia, the more power one has. In a society where hierarchy is determined by this power, F-rank Park Jinsung has always been his school's punching bag. In reality, though, he is an S-rank with extreme bloodlust, which he has been hiding to keep others safe. With only two years left of high school, will Jinsung be able to hide his killer side and prove rank isn't everything?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: My School Life Pretending To Be a Worthless Person

153996.description:
Tamer is a profession that can tame monsters and use them as familiars. That was the vocation of the main character Kohaku, but he couldn't tame ordinary monsters. As a result, he was called "incompetent" and banished from the guild. However, he had a special power that allowed only him to tame the mythical "Phantasma", a legendary species so power and so rare that they have never been seen in public.

(Source: Comic Nova, translated)

153998.description: “Jun Aiba, will you give me your life?”. On the last Christmas of his high school life, Jun Aiba, who is having a hard time living, makes a deal with a woman who calls herself the God of Death. In exchange for his life span, Aiba obtains a watch that can rewind time, and uses the power of the watch to realize his ideal life. Aiba tries to spend the remaining three years of his life without any inconvenience, but his life changes drastically when he interrupts the suicide of a girl who was supposed to die. Aiba decides to keep interfering until Tsukimi Ichinose, a girl who wants to die, gives up on suicide. He spends his days struggling against Ichinose, who refuses to give up on her suicide.

title.native: 死にたがりな少女の自殺を邪魔して、遊びにつれていく話。

153999.description:
Kohaku was supposed to be a monster-tamer, but he was completely unable to tame any ordinary monster. So he was labeled as "incompetent," but in fact, he was the only one who could take on the "phantasma", the legendary beast species! Kohaku, who had been banished by his guild in his home town, began to play an active role as soon as he moved to another country where he learned more about the phantasma! Furthermore, the phantasma monsters became attracted to him and began to chase after him! It's the carefree slow-life of the world's one and only phantasma tamer!

(Source: Hifumishobo, translated)
